hero.title: AKS University
hero.summary: AKS University in Satna offers agriculture through its Faculty of Agriculture Science and Technology. Its published curriculum spans crop science, horticulture and agricultural engineering, while the Department of Agronomy connects teaching with crop research and extension work.

overview.heading: Crop science within a wider agricultural faculty
paragraphs: The undergraduate agriculture course at AKS sits within a faculty that also publishes curricula for agricultural engineering, food technology and several postgraduate agricultural subjects. This allows applicants to distinguish a broad first degree from later specialist study rather than treating every agriculture-related course as the same qualification.

The agronomy department dates its establishment to 2014. Its published teaching and research interests include crop production, soil management and weed control. The department also describes farmer training and field demonstrations, giving a concrete extension context to academic work. Applicants can progress from the broad undergraduate degree to specialist agronomy study, subject to the published qualification and practical-work requirements.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: The published curriculum introduces soil science, agronomy, horticulture, genetics, plant pathology and agricultural economics.

admissions.heading: Planning an agriculture application
admissions.intro: AKS links an online admission portal and publishes a 2026-27 fee-and-eligibility table. Applicants can compare the base semester fee with the university’s category-specific scholarship columns before requesting their final offer.
eligibility_points: M.Sc. Agronomy requires B.Sc. Agriculture with 60%, RAWE and experiential work.

steps.title: Check the course requirements
steps.text: Read the published agriculture qualification and any selection requirement under the university ordinance.

steps.title: Complete the application
steps.text: AKS accepts its online form or an offline form obtained through the admissions office.

steps.title: Submit the required records
steps.text: Provide qualifying records and identity/transfer/character documents from the official common checklist.

steps.title: Confirm admission and enrolment
steps.text: After the admissions section issues confirmation, complete the specified payment, registration and enrolment formalities.

documents: Educational certificates and qualifying mark sheets for Class X, XII and the applicable UG/PG qualification.
Aadhaar or the specified identity proof.

campus.heading: Agronomy, research and farmer extension
campus.intro: The agronomy department reports practical training alongside classroom teaching. Its extension activities include workshops, field visits and demonstrations intended to connect university knowledge with farming practice.

facilities.name: Faculty teaching laboratories
facilities.description: The faculty lists soil and water conservation, farm machinery, irrigation and remote-sensing laboratories; several support agricultural-engineering teaching.

facilities.name: Field and protected-cultivation training
facilities.description: An experimental learning field, micro-irrigation training setup and polyhouse appear in the faculty list.

facilities.name: Food-processing incubation
facilities.description: The faculty identifies a food-processing and preservation incubation centre.

practical_learning: Department-led farmer training and demonstrations are described on the agronomy page.
The B.Sc. curriculum assigns practical credit to subjects including soil science, crop physiology and entomology.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: The 2026-27 table gives a General/OBC university scholarship of INR 7,000 per semester for B.Sc. Agriculture and INR 2,000 for M.Sc. Agronomy. Confirm award and continuation conditions before relying on the reduced payable fee.

schemes.name: University scholarship: General/OBC fee table
schemes.details: Published semester reductions for the listed agriculture courses; individual eligibility is subject to university confirmation.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The agronomy department describes campus recruitment, career counselling and preparation for interviews and CV writing. These are support activities; the checked page does not supply a dated agriculture placement rate or salary distribution.

recognition.heading: Recognition and programme accreditation
recognition.text: ICAR lists AKS University, Satna, M.P. for 2022-10-11 to 2027-10-10. The exact degree labels appear below. Printed intake belongs to the accreditation record and does not establish current admission seat availability.

faculty.intro: The Agronomy department names Dr. Dheerendra Prasad Chaturvedi as its head. This selected entry comes from the undated departmental page checked on 31 October 2026; a complete current staffing certificate was not established.

faqs.question: Which AKS agriculture degree appears in the ICAR register?
faqs.answer: The audited entry names B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture for 11 October 2022 to 10 October 2027.

faqs.question: How long is the undergraduate agriculture course?
faqs.answer: The university admissions listing gives four years.

faqs.question: Does AKS offer postgraduate agronomy?
faqs.answer: Yes. Its agronomy department lists a two-year M.Sc. requiring a B.Sc. Agriculture qualification.

faqs.question: What does the agriculture curriculum cover?
faqs.answer: The published course structure includes crops, soils, horticulture, plant health and agricultural economics, with theory and practical credits.

faqs.question: What is the B.Sc. Agriculture fee for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The official table gives INR 55,000 per semester before its General/OBC scholarship; that column shows INR 48,000 payable. Registration is separate.
